# Testing the intra-species hourglass model

Statistically test whether the two cell lineages (fusiform & ray lineages) share higher transcriptomic similarity at mid developmental stage.

## Setup

```{r Library}
library(Seurat, quietly = TRUE)
library(slingshot, quietly = TRUE)
library(dtw, quietly = TRUE)
library(sccore, quietly = TRUE)
library(magrittr, quietly = TRUE)
library(Matrix, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggplot2, quietly = TRUE)
library(pheatmap, quietly = TRUE)
library(foreach, quietly = TRUE)
# library(doParallel, quietly = TRUE)
library(doSNOW, quietly = TRUE)
```

Configure for parallel processing

```{r Configure for parallel processing}
Sys.setenv(
  OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
  VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1"
)
get_n_workers <- function(n_tasks, requested = params$n_parallel) {
  slurm_cpus <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", unset = NA_character_))
  )

  available <- if (is.na(slurm_cpus)) {
    max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) - 1L)
  } else {
    slurm_cpus
  }

  max(
    1L, 
    min(as.integer(requested), as.integer(n_tasks), available)
  )
}
make_parallel_progress <- function(n) {
  pb <- utils::txtProgressBar(
    min = 0,
    max = n,
    style = 3,
    file = stderr()
  )

  list(
    pb = pb,
    snow_options = list(
      progress = function(completed) {
        utils::setTxtProgressBar(
          pb,
          completed
        )
      },

      # Required for progress to update as individual tasks finish.
      preschedule = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

Helper functions

```{r Define helper functions}
logcpm <- function(x) {
  log2(1 + 1e6 * sweep(as.matrix(x), 2, colSums(x), "/"))
}
calculate_js_similarity <- function(mat1, mat2) {
  out <- jsDist(cbind(mat1, mat2))[
      1:ncol(mat1),
      (ncol(mat1)+1):(ncol(mat1)+ncol(mat2))
  ]
  rownames(out) <- colnames(mat1)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat2)
  return(1 - out)
}
calculate_similarity <- function(mat1, mat2, metrics) {
  stopifnot(metrics %in% c("spearman", "pearson", "Jensen-Shannon"))
  if (metrics %in% c("spearman", "pearson")) {
    cor(
      x = logcpm(mat1),
      y = logcpm(mat2),
      method = metrics
    )
  } else if (metrics == "Jensen-Shannon") {
    calculate_js_similarity(
      as.matrix(mat1),
      as.matrix(mat2)
    )
  }
}
```

## Test hourglass along pseudotime

**The procedure:**

1.  Infer pseudotime along cell lineages using Slingshot based on PCA coordinates.

2.  Aggregate expression by pseudotime bins (by `n_bins`).

3.  Calculate pairwise similarity between bins across lineages (using `metric`).

4.  Align cell lineages by bins using a Dynamic Time Wrapping (DTW) algorithm. (using `window_size`)

5.  Calculate the `hourglass score` based on cell lineage alignment.

    Hourglass score is defined as follows:

    Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

    $$
    E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
    M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
    L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
    $$

    The hourglass score was then defined as

    $$
    H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
    $$

    A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

6.  Permutation for the null distribution of the hourglass score\

    (1) Shuffle pseudotime values\
    (2) Repeat Step 2-5\
    (3) Estimate permutation p-value

7.  Bootstrapping for the confidence interval of the hourglass score\

    (1) Re-sample cells with replacement\
    (2) Repeat Step 1-5\
    (3) Estimate bootstrap confidence interval

### 1. Pseudotime inference

Slingshot pseudotimes were inferred based on PCA coordinates

```{r Create SlingshotDataSet}
slingshot_manual <- function(seurat_obj) {
  lineages <- new("SlingshotDataSet")

  # add cell embedding
  lineages@reducedDim <- seurat_obj %>% 
    Embeddings(reduction = "pca") %>% 
    extract(1:dim(seurat_obj)[2], 1:10) %>%
    as.matrix
  
  # add cluster matrix
  clusters <- seurat_obj$cell_label # factor
  mtx_clus <- matrix(0, nrow=length(clusters), ncol=length(levels(clusters)))
  row.names(mtx_clus) <- names(clusters)
  colnames(mtx_clus) <- levels(clusters)
  for (i in seq(length(clusters))) {
    mtx_clus[names(clusters)[i], clusters[i]] <- 1
  }
  lineages@clusterLabels <- mtx_clus
  
  # add lineages
  lineages@lineages <- list(
    "Lineage1" = c(
      "Fusiform Organizer", 
      "Fusiform Early Precursor", 
      "Fusiform Intermediate Precursor", 
      "Fiber"
    ),
    "Lineage2" = c(
      "Fusiform Organizer",
      "Fusiform Early Precursor",
      "Fusiform Intermediate Precursor",
      "Vessel"
    ),
    "Lineage3" = c(
      "Ray Organizer", 
      "Ray Precursor", 
      "Ray"
    )
  )
  
  # add adjacency matrix
  mtx_adj <- matrix(0, nrow = length(levels(clusters)), ncol = length(levels(clusters)))
  row.names(mtx_adj) <- colnames(mtx_adj) <- levels(clusters)
  for (l_i in lineages@lineages) {
    for (c_i in seq(length(l_i) - 1)) {
      mtx_adj[l_i[c_i], l_i[c_i + 1]] <- 1
      mtx_adj[l_i[c_i + 1], l_i[c_i]] <- 1
    }
  }
  lineages@adjacency <- mtx_adj
  

  # fit curves
  # message("Slingshot fit curve start: ", Sys.time())
  curves <- getCurves(
    lineages,
    approx_points = 100
  ) %>% SlingshotDataSet
  # message("Slingshot fit curve finished: ", Sys.time())
  
  # estimate pseudotime
  pseudotime <- slingPseudotime(
    curves,
    na = FALSE
  )
  branch_id <- slingBranchID(
    curves
  )
  return(
    list(
      SlingshotDataSet = curves,
      pseudotime = pseudotime,
      branch_id = branch_id
    )
  )
}
```

### 2. Bin expression by pseudotime

Expression was aggregated within equal-width pseudotime bins independently for each lineage.

Fusiform and ray bins were subsequently aligned using a constrained monotonic DTW (Dynamic Time Warping) path.

```{r Bin expression}
bin_expression <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    pseudotime_mtx, 
    branch_id, 
    lineage,
    exclude = c(),
    prefix, 
    n_bins
) {
  # get pseudotime values
  pt <- pseudotime_mtx[, lineage]

  # keep only cells belongs to the lineage
  keep <- branch_id %>% grepl(lineage, .)
  keep <- keep & (!seurat_obj$cell_label %in% exclude)
  pt <- pt[keep]

  # set bins 
  bins <- cut(
    pt, 
    breaks = seq(
      min(pt),
      max(pt),
      length.out = n_bins + 1    
    ),
    labels = FALSE, 
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  names(bins) <- names(pt)
  
  # subset lineage cells
  obj <- subset(seurat_obj, cells = names(pt))
  obj$bin <- sprintf("%s-%02d", prefix, bins[colnames(obj)])
  
  # aggregate pseudotime
  pb <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "RNA", group.by = "bin")$RNA
  pb <- pb[, order(colnames(pb)), drop = FALSE]
  
  # report cell label composition by bins
  comp <- table(
    bin = bins,
    cell_type = seurat_obj$cell_label[keep]
  )
  return(list(Pseudobulk = pb, Composition = comp))
}

n_bins <- params$n_bins

res_L1 <- bin_expression(

  pseudotime_mtx = pseudotime,
  branch_id = branch_id,

  prefix = "Fusiform-Fiber"
```

### 4. Align pseudotime bins

Find the correspondence between lineage pseudotime by the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm:

```{r Define align_similarity_matrix}
align_similarity_matrix <- function(
  similarity,
  window_size = ceiling(as.numeric(params$window_dtw) * max(dim(similarity)))
) {
  local_cost <- 1 - similarity
  fit <- dtw(
    x = local_cost,
    y = NULL,
    step.pattern = dtw::asymmetric, # Each ray bin is matched exactly once.
    window.type = "slantedband",
    window.size = window_size,
    open.begin = TRUE,
    open.end = TRUE,
    keep.internals = TRUE,
    distance.only = FALSE
  )

  path <- tibble::tibble(
    L1_i = fit$index1,
    L2_i = fit$index2,
    L1_bin = rownames(similarity)[fit$index1],
    L2_bin = colnames(similarity)[fit$index2],
    similarity = similarity[
      cbind(fit$index1, fit$index2)
    ]
  )
  list(
    fit = fit,
    path = path,
    local_cost = local_cost
  )
}
```

Plot aligned paths

```{r Plot DTW path}
plot_dtw_path <- function(
  similarity,
  aligned,
  title
) {
  similarity <- as.matrix(similarity)

  stopifnot(
    max(aligned$path$L1_i) <= nrow(similarity),
    max(aligned$path$L2_i) <= ncol(similarity)
  )

  heatmap_data <- expand.grid(
    L1_i = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
    L2_i = seq_len(ncol(similarity))
  )

  heatmap_data$similarity <- similarity[
    cbind(
      heatmap_data$L1_i,
      heatmap_data$L2_i
    )
  ]

  ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(
      x = L2_i,
      y = L1_i,
      fill = similarity
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_path(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = aligned$path,
      aes(
        x = L2_i,
        y = L1_i
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "RdYlBu", 
      direction = -1
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(ncol(similarity)),
      labels = colnames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_reverse(
      breaks = seq_len(nrow(similarity)),
      labels = rownames(similarity),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        hjust = 1,
        vjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Fusiform reference bin",
      y = "Ray query bin",
      fill = "similarity",
      title = title
    )
}
```

Summarize cell type correspondence along the aligned path

```{r}
composition_proportions <- function(comp, states) {
  comp <- as.matrix(comp)
  out <- matrix(
    0, nrow = nrow(comp), ncol = length(states), 
    dimnames = list(rownames(comp), states)
  )
  shared_states <- intersect(colnames(comp), states)

  out[, shared_states] <- comp[, shared_states, drop = FALSE]

  totals <- rowSums(out)

  sweep(out, 1, totals, "/")
}
extract_bin_id <- function(x) {
  x %>% 
    sub("^.*-(\\d+)$", "\\1", .) %>%
    as.integer %>%
    as.character
}
alignment_label_mass <- function(
    aligned,
    comp_query,
    comp_reference,
    query_states,
    reference_states
) {
  # get cell state proportion in
  query_prop <- composition_proportions(comp_query, query_states)
  reference_prop <- composition_proportions(comp_reference, reference_states)

  # get alignment path
  path <- aligned$path
  query_bin <- extract_bin_id(path$L1_bin)
  reference_bin <- extract_bin_id(path$L2_bin)

  
  mass <- matrix(
    0, nrow = length(query_states), ncol = length(reference_states),
    dimnames = list(query_state = query_states, reference_state = reference_states)
  )

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(path))) {
    mass <- mass + tcrossprod(
        query_prop[query_bin[k], , drop = TRUE],
        reference_prop[reference_bin[k], , drop = TRUE]
      )
  }

  # Equal weight for each Ray pseudotime position.
  mass <- mass / nrow(path)

  stopifnot(
    isTRUE(all.equal(sum(mass), 1, tolerance = 1e-8))
  )

  mass
}
```

```{r Plot simialrity along the alinged path}
    xmax = max(modules$L3$middle) + 0.5,
    ymin = min(aligned_L1$path$similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymax = max(aligned_L1$path$similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "purple"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
      x = "Pseudotime bin",
      y = sprintf("Transcriptomic similarity (%s)", params$metric)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
p_alinged_similarity2 <- ggplot(
    data = aligned_L2$path,
    aes(
      x = L1_i, 
      y = similarity, 
    )
  ) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = min(modules$L3$middle) - 0.5,
    xmax = max(modules$L3$middle) + 0.5,
    ymin = min(aligned_L2$path$similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    ymax = max(aligned_L2$path$similarity, na.rm = TRUE),
    alpha = 0.2,
    fill = "purple"
  ) +

  ) +

p_alinged_similarity1 / p_alinged_similarity2
```

### 5. Calculate hourglass score

Hourglass score is defined as follows:

Let $S_i$ denote the transcriptomic similarity at aligned pseudotime position $i$, and let $\mathcal{E}$, $\mathcal{M}$, and $\mathcal{L}$ denote the sets of early-, middle-, and late-stage positions, respectively. Stage-specific mean similarities were calculated as

$$
E=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{E}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{E}}S_i,\qquad
M=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{M}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}S_i,\qquad
L=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{L}|}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{L}}S_i.
$$

The hourglass score was then defined as

$$
H=\min\left\{M-E,\;M-L\right\}.
$$

A positive score requires the middle-stage similarity to exceed both the early- and late-stage similarities.

```{r Define function for calculating hourglass scores}
hourglass_score <- function(S, modules) {
  E <- mean(S[modules$early], na.rm = TRUE)
  M <- mean(S[modules$middle], na.rm = TRUE)
  L <- mean(S[modules$late], na.rm = TRUE)
  c(
    Early = E,
    Middle = M,
    Late = L,
    H = min(M - E, M - L)
  )
}
```

```{r Calculate the hourglass score}
scores_observed <- rbind(
  hourglass_score(S_L1, modules$L3),
  hourglass_score(S_L2, modules$L3)
) %>% 
  as.data.frame %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    comparison = c("Fiber-Ray", "Vessel-Ray"),
    permutation = "Observed"
  )

scores_observed
```

### 6. Permutation test

Permute pseudotime ordering along the ray lineage, repeat the previous procedure, and estimate the null distribution of the hourglass score.

```{r Permutation test, echo=TRUE, results='hide'}
# get params
n_permutation <- as.integer(params$n_permutation)
metric <- as.character(params$metric)

# logical for subseting ray lineage pseudotime
ray_keep <- grepl("3", branch_id) & is.finite(pseudotime[, 3])
ray_pt <- pseudotime[ray_keep, 3]

# get permutation seeds
set.seed(42)
permutation_seeds <- sample.int(
  n = .Machine$integer.max,
  size = n_permutation,
  replace = FALSE
)

# register paralelle backend
n_workers_perm <- get_n_workers(
  n_tasks = n_permutation
)
message(
  "Running ", n_permutation, " permutations on ", n_workers_perm, " workers."
)
cl_perm <- parallel::makeCluster(
  n_workers_perm
)
registerDoSNOW(
  cl_perm
)

# create progress bar
perm_progress <- make_parallel_progress(
  n_permutation
)

# run permutation
scores_perm_list <- tryCatch(
  {
    foreach::foreach(
      i = seq_len(n_permutation),
      .inorder = FALSE,
      .options.snow = perm_progress$snow_options,
      .packages = c(
        "Seurat",
        "Matrix",
        "magrittr",
        "dtw",
        "sccore",
        "tibble"
      )
    ) %dopar% {
      
      # permute pseudotime
      pt_i <- pseudotime
      set.seed(permutation_seeds[i])
      pt_i[ray_keep, 3] <- sample(
        ray_pt,
        replace = FALSE
      )

      # bin expression
      res_L3_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
        pseudotime_mtx = pt_i,
        branch_id = branch_id,
        lineage = 3,
        n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = "Ray"
      )
      pb_L3_i <- res_L3_i$Pseudobulk
  
      # calculate similarity
      similarity_L1_perm_i <- calculate_similarity(
        pb_L1[genes, , drop = FALSE],
        pb_L3_i[genes, , drop = FALSE],
        metrics = metric
      )
      similarity_L2_perm_i <- calculate_similarity(
        pb_L2[genes, , drop = FALSE],
        pb_L3_i[genes, , drop = FALSE],
        metrics = metric
      )

      # align bins based on similarity
      aligned_L1_perm_i <- align_similarity_matrix(
        t(similarity_L1_perm_i)
      )
      aligned_L2_perm_i <- align_similarity_matrix(
        t(similarity_L2_perm_i)
      )
  
      # calculate hourglass score based on alinged trajectory
      score_matrix <- rbind(
        hourglass_score(
          aligned_L1_perm_i$path$similarity,
          modules$L3
        ),
        hourglass_score(
          aligned_L2_perm_i$path$similarity,
          modules$L3
        )
      )

      # output
      data.frame(
        score_matrix,
        comparison = c(
          "Fiber-Ray",
          "Vessel-Ray"
        ),
        permutation = sprintf(
          "Permutation-%d",
          i
        ),
        seed = permutation_seeds[i],
        row.names = NULL,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    }
  },
  finally = {
    close(perm_progress$pb)
    parallel::stopCluster(cl_perm)
    foreach::registerDoSEQ()
  }
)

scores_perm <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  scores_perm_list
)
```

Calculate the permutation p-value

```{r Calculate the permutation p-value}
observed_H <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_obs = H
  )

permutation_results <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(H)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H_perm = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    observed_H,
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_obs = dplyr::first(H_obs),
    n_permutation = dplyr::n_distinct(permutation),
    n_null_ge_observed = sum(H_perm >= dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    null_mean = mean(H_perm),
    null_median = median(H_perm),
    null_sd = stats::sd(H_perm),
    null_q025 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.025)),
    null_q95 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.95)),
    null_q975 = unname(stats::quantile(H_perm, 0.975)),
    observed_minus_null_mean = dplyr::first(H_obs) - mean(H_perm),
    observed_percentile = mean(H_perm < dplyr::first(H_obs)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # One-sided empirical permutation P value
    p_empirical = (n_null_ge_observed + 1) / (n_permutation + 1),
    # Adjust p-value
    p_holm = stats::p.adjust(p_empirical, method = "holm")
  )

permutation_results
```

Calculate the one-sided joint permutation $P$-value using $H_{\mathrm{joint}}=\min(H_{\mathrm{Fiber\text{-}Ray}},H_{\mathrm{Vessel\text{-}Ray}})$, as the proportion of permuted joint scores at least as large as the observed joint score.

```{r Calcualte the joint p-value}
H_joint_observed <- min(scores_observed$H)
H_joint_perm <- scores_perm %>%
  dplyr::select(
    permutation,
    comparison,
    H
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    H_joint = pmin(
      `Fiber-Ray`,
      `Vessel-Ray`
    )
  )

p_joint <- (
  sum(H_joint_perm$H_joint >= H_joint_observed) + 1L
) / (
  nrow(H_joint_perm) + 1L
)
p_joint
```

### 7. Bootstrapping

Re-sample cells with replacement, repeat the procedure for estimating the hourglass score, and calculate the confidence interval of the hourglass score.

```{r Define bootstrapping helper functions}
# Re-sampling cells from a SeuratObject with replacement
make_bootstrap_seurat <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    seed,
    assay = "RNA"
) {
  set.seed(seed)

  n_cells <- ncol(seurat_obj)

  # Bootstrap draw: integer indices preserve repeated selections.
  sampled_idx <- sample.int(
    n = n_cells,
    size = n_cells,
    replace = TRUE
  )

  source_cells <- Cells(seurat_obj)[sampled_idx]

  # Extract raw counts, preserving duplicated columns.
  counts_boot <- LayerData(
    seurat_obj,
    assay = assay,
    layer = "counts"
  )[, sampled_idx, drop = FALSE]

  # Every bootstrap draw requires its own unique object-level ID.
  bootstrap_cells <- sprintf(
    "Boot-%05d__%s",
    seq_len(n_cells),
    source_cells
  )

  colnames(counts_boot) <- bootstrap_cells

  # Copy metadata according to the same sampled indices.
  meta_boot <- seurat_obj[[]][
    sampled_idx,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  meta_boot$source_cell <- source_cells
  meta_boot$bootstrap_draw <- seq_len(n_cells)

  rownames(meta_boot) <- bootstrap_cells

  # Let CreateSeuratObject recalculate these fields.
  qc_columns <- intersect(
    c(
      paste0("nCount_", assay),
      paste0("nFeature_", assay)
    ),
    colnames(meta_boot)
  )

  meta_boot <- meta_boot[
    ,
    setdiff(colnames(meta_boot), qc_columns),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  object_boot <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts_boot,
    assay = assay,
    meta.data = meta_boot,
    project = paste0(Project(seurat_obj), "_bootstrap")
  )

  # Preserve your published biological labels.
  if ("cell_label" %in% colnames(object_boot[[]])) {
    Idents(object_boot) <- "cell_label"
  }

  list(
    object = object_boot,
    sampled_idx = sampled_idx,
    source_cells = source_cells
  )
}

run_bootstrap_once <- function(seed) {
  # Encourage R to release the large temporary Seurat objects
  # after this replicate finishes.
  on.exit(gc(), add = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 1. Uniformly resample cells and retain published labels
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      resampling_i <- make_bootstrap_seurat(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
        seed = seed
      )
      seurat_obj_i <- resampling_i$object

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 2. Repeat the same preprocessing used in the current Rmd
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      seurat_obj_i <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
      seurat_obj_i <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i, verbose = FALSE)
      seurat_obj_i <- ScaleData(
        seurat_obj_i,
        features = VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i),
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      seurat_obj_i <- RunPCA(seurat_obj_i, npcs = 10, verbose = FALSE)

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 3. Re-estimate pseudotime
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      slingshot_res_i <- suppressWarnings(
        slingshot_manual(seurat_obj_i)
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 4. Reconstruct lineage pseudobulks
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      res_L1_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj_i,
        pseudotime_mtx = slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
        branch_id = slingshot_res_i$branch_id,
        lineage = 1,
        n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = "Fusiform-Fiber"
      )
      res_L2_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj_i,
        pseudotime_mtx = slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
        branch_id = slingshot_res_i$branch_id,
        lineage = 2,
        n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = "Fusiform-Vessel"
      )
      res_L3_i <- bin_expression(
        seurat_obj = seurat_obj_i,
        pseudotime_mtx = slingshot_res_i$pseudotime,
        branch_id = slingshot_res_i$branch_id,
        lineage = 3,
        n_bins = n_bins,
        prefix = "Ray"
      )
      pb_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Pseudobulk
      pb_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Pseudobulk
      pb_L3_i <- res_L3_i$Pseudobulk
      comp_L1_i <- res_L1_i$Composition
      comp_L2_i <- res_L2_i$Composition
      comp_L3_i <- res_L3_i$Composition
      
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 5. Identify the middle Ray stage
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      prop_L3_i <- as.data.frame(
        comp_L3_i / rowSums(comp_L3_i)
      )
      middle_i <- prop_L3_i %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          cell_type == "Ray Precursor",
          Freq > 0.5
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(bin)

      # table() normally makes bin a factor; convert safely.
      middle_i <- sort(unique(as.integer(as.character(middle_i))))

      if (
        length(middle_i) == 0L ||
        anyNA(middle_i)
      ) {
        stop("No Ray Precursor-majority middle bin was found.")
      }

      if (
        min(middle_i) <= 1L ||
        max(middle_i) >= n_bins
      ) {
        stop("The middle stage touches a trajectory endpoint.")
      }

      modules_i <- list(
        L3 = list(
          early = seq_len(min(middle_i) - 1L),
          middle = middle_i,
          late = seq.int(max(middle_i) + 1L, n_bins)
        )
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 6. Select genes for this end-to-end bootstrap replicate
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      genes_i <- Reduce(
        intersect,
        list(
          rownames(pb_L1_i),
          rownames(pb_L2_i),
          rownames(pb_L3_i)
        )
      )
      genes_i <- intersect(
        genes_i,
        VariableFeatures(seurat_obj_i)
      )
      if (length(genes_i) < 2L) {
        stop("Too few variable genes remained.")
      }

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 7. Calculate transcriptomic similarity
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      similarity_L1_i <- calculate_similarity(
        pb_L1_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
        pb_L3_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
        metrics = metric
      )
      similarity_L2_i <- calculate_similarity(
        pb_L2_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
        pb_L3_i[genes_i, , drop = FALSE],
        metrics = metric
      )

      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 8. Re-estimate DTW alignments
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      aligned_L1_i <- align_similarity_matrix(
        t(similarity_L1_i)
      )
      aligned_L2_i <- align_similarity_matrix(
        t(similarity_L2_i)
      )
      
      # report cell state alignment 
      alignment_mass_L1_i <- alignment_label_mass(
        aligned = aligned_L1_i,
        comp_query = comp_L3_i,
        comp_reference = comp_L1_i,
        query_states = ray_lineage,
        reference_states = fusiform_lineage
      )
      alignment_mass_L2_i <- alignment_label_mass(
        aligned = aligned_L2_i,
        comp_query = comp_L3_i,
        comp_reference = comp_L2_i,
        query_states = ray_lineage,
        reference_states = fusiform_lineage
      )


      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      # 9. Calculate bootstrap hourglass scores
      # ------------------------------------------------------------
      score_matrix <- rbind(
        hourglass_score(
          aligned_L1_i$path$similarity,
          modules_i$L3
        ),
        hourglass_score(
          aligned_L2_i$path$similarity,
          modules_i$L3
        )
      )
      scores <- data.frame(
        score_matrix,
        comparison = c(
          "Fiber-Ray",
          "Vessel-Ray"
        ),
        bootstrap = seed,
        row.names = NULL,
        check.names = FALSE
      )
      list(
        ok = TRUE,
        seed = seed,
        scores = scores,
        alignment_mass = list(
          `Fiber-Ray` = alignment_mass_L1_i,
          `Vessel-Ray` = alignment_mass_L2_i
        ),
        error = NA_character_
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        ok = FALSE,
        seed = seed,
        scores = NULL,
        alignment_mass = NULL,
        error = conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
summarize_alignment_mass <- function(
    bootstrap_output,
    bootstrap_ok,
    comparison
) {
  mass_list <- lapply(
    bootstrap_output[bootstrap_ok],
    function(x) {
      x$alignment_mass[[comparison]]
    }
  )

  mass_array <- simplify2array(mass_list)

  list(
    mean = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), mean),
    median = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), median),
    lower = apply(mass_array, c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper = apply(mass_array,c(1, 2), stats::quantile, probs = 0.975),
    array = mass_array
  )
}
```

Calculate confidence interval

```{r Calculate confidence interval}
scores_observed_ci <- scores_observed %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

scores_bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    M_minus_E = Middle - Early,
    M_minus_L = Middle - Late
  )

bootstrap_ci <- scores_bootstrap_ci %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_bootstrap = dplyr::n_distinct(bootstrap),

    H_median = median(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    H_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_E_median = median(M_minus_E, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_E_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_E_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_E, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),

    M_minus_L_median = median(M_minus_L, na.rm = TRUE),
    M_minus_L_ci_lower = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    M_minus_L_ci_upper = unname(quantile(M_minus_L, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    scores_observed_ci %>%
      dplyr::select(
        comparison,
        H_observed = H,
        M_minus_E_observed = M_minus_E,
        M_minus_L_observed = M_minus_L
      ),
    by = "comparison"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    comparison,
    H_observed,
    H_median,
    H_ci_lower,
    H_ci_upper,
    M_minus_E_observed,
    M_minus_E_ci_lower,
    M_minus_E_ci_upper,
    M_minus_L_observed,
    M_minus_L_ci_lower,
    M_minus_L_ci_upper,
    n_bootstrap
  )
```

```{r Calculate joint confidence interval}
  dplyr::select(bootstrap, comparison, H) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = H
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(`Fiber-Ray`),
    is.finite(`Vessel-Ray`)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    H_joint = pmin(
      `Fiber-Ray`,
      `Vessel-Ray`
    )
  )

joint_bootstrap_ci <- H_joint_bootstrap %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    H_joint_observed = H_joint_observed,
    H_joint_median = median(
      H_joint,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    H_joint_ci_lower = unname(quantile(H_joint, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    H_joint_ci_upper = unname(quantile(H_joint, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n_bootstrap = sum(is.finite(H_joint))
  )

joint_bootstrap_ci
```

Plot bootstrap hourglass scores

```{r Plot bootstrap hourglass scores}
ggplot(
  scores_bootstrap,
  aes(x = H)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 40
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = scores_observed,
    aes(xintercept = H),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ comparison,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Bootstrap hourglass score",
    y = "Number of bootstrap replicates",
    title = "Cell-bootstrap distributions of the hourglass statistic",
    subtitle = "Vertical lines indicate observed scores"
  )
```
